observation_windows.finding: The wait from archive availability to the next paper tick dominated the sampled decision path. The tick cadence was about 5.5 seconds.

observation_windows.systemd_start_limit: Default 5 starts per 10 seconds caused repeated start-limit-hit events and roughly 6.5-second gaps after bursts of five starts.

observation_windows.finding: Service processing was small; the collector's one-second batch flush and remaining archive-to-tick age exceeded the one-second quote contract too often.

All 63 scheduled checkpoints had a same-connection HYPE quote within the frozen 1000ms bound. This was a quote availability observation only; the reviewed strategy session was suspended and no order decisions or fills were running.

failure_reasons: Quote freshness was 993/1069 (92.89%), below the frozen 95% gate; 76 decision checkpoints used same-connection BBO observations older than 1000 ms.
The stale age p95 was 1744 ms (maximum 7813 ms). Tick cadence (p95 569 ms, maximum 576 ms), receipt-to-archive p95 (259 ms), connection continuity, and systemd start limits passed.
The archived HYPE BBO feed is event-driven: unchanged books produced no new source receipt during several multi-second intervals. Heartbeat was not treated as a quote refresh.
observation_windows.reconstruction_note: The ten-minute window ran continuously. Initial summarization hit a variable-name error after collection; this result was reconstructed from systemd service-start timestamps and archived raw observation receipt/archive timestamps without restarting the services.

targeted_changes.collector: Flush pending bbo channel observations every 250ms; other market channels retain the existing one-second batch cadence.

requirements: One continuous WebSocket session throughout the gate; any reconnect resets the window.
No systemd start-limit hits and the same quote/decision age calculation used in this report.
Register the new plan and frozen variant only after the collection gate passes; then start with a fresh, non-transferred ledger after the immutable incomplete disposition.

limitations: Timer starts are quote-availability checkpoints, not executions; no paper session was active during this observation.
A 35-second sample with 100 percent eligible quotes does not satisfy the ten-minute launch gate.
No live entry, exit, or profitability result is claimed.

last_decision.reason: Preserve failed BBO-only gate; no retroactive l2Book credit. New l2Book evidence supports a separately versioned v4 contract proposal, not a v3 launch.

next_control.action: One read-only check of the failed latest gate, timer state and v3 session count; it performs no collection and cannot launch an experiment.
